annotations.title: Get the VBS Readiness PC scanner

description:
FREE. Returns the download link and usage instructions for VBS Readiness, a free read-only PowerShell scanner (Windows 10/11) that finds every VBScript dependency on a PC or share (files, scheduled tasks, Run keys, Group Policy scripts, executions logged as event 4096) and new-Outlook blockers (COM add-ins, VBA macros, PST files). Use it when a user needs to inventory VBScript before Windows disables it, then convert the scripts found with convert_vbscript_to_powershell.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.
name: get_readiness_scanner
